cards.name: Bellowing Flames
cards.text: 對一個手下造成5點傷害 鑄造：再造成5點傷害，隨機分給全部敵方手下
cards.textEn: Deal 5 damage to a minion. Forge: Then deal 5 damage split among all enemy minions.

cards.name: Flame Ward
cards.text: 秘密：在手下攻擊你英雄後，對全部敵方手下造成3點傷害
cards.textEn: Secret: After a minion attacks your hero, deal 3 damage to all enemy minions.

cards.name: Plague of Flames
cards.text: 摧毀全部友方手下。摧毀相同數量的隨機敵方手下
cards.textEn: Destroy all your minions. For each one, destroy a random enemy minion.

cards.name: Volcano
cards.text: 造成15點傷害， 隨機分給全部手下 超載：(1)
cards.textEn: Deal 15 damage randomly split among all minions. Overload: (1)

cards.name: Acidmaw
cards.text: 每當一個敵方手下受到傷害，摧毀該手下
cards.textEn: Whenever an enemy minion takes damage, destroy it.

cards.name: Dreadscale
cards.text: 在你的回合結束時，對全部敵人 造成1點傷害
cards.textEn: At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to all enemies.

cards.name: Reno, Lone Ranger
cards.text: 戰吼：如果你的牌堆開始時沒有重複的卡牌，從賽局中移除全部敵方手下
cards.textEn: Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, remove all enemy minions from the game.

cards.name: Sickly Grimewalker
cards.text: 在你召喚不死族後，賦予它致命劇毒
cards.textEn: After you summon an Undead, give it Poisonous.

cards.name: Hysteria
cards.text: 選擇一個敵方手下，該手下會攻擊隨機手下直到死亡為止
cards.textEn: Choose an enemy minion. It attacks random minions until it dies.
